#### About us
Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
#### Job description
In order to support Manoeuvre Loads Team in Hamburg, Airbus is looking for a
# **Loads & Aeroelastic Engineer (d/f/m** **)**
As Loads & Aeroelastic Engineer (d/f/m) we are at the heart of aircraft design and deal as part of the engineering organisation with the key flight sciences.
In the Manoeuvre Loads Team in Hamburg we perform load calculations covering our fleet from a very early design stage until certification and finally during airline operations. We are responsible for build model activities such as aerodynamics modelling for the manoeuvre loads models and integrating model bricks. We subsequently perform manoeuvre loads calculation and provide the loads data to our component loads colleagues. In addition to this, the team is strongly involved in performing loads in-service support,  research and technology aspects with new aircraft configuration assessments, new services, model based system engineering, automation, and machine learning.
Having the transverse view of the whole aircraft, our main mission is to deliver suitable aircraft design and configuration for optimum performance. As such we are fully part of the current and future challenges in designing a safe aircraft meeting the highest sustainability and operational standards.
We are present throughout the full aircraft life-cycle: supporting sales campaigns from early definition phase through the core design phase and onwards into supporting manufacture, flight testing and the aircraft in service. By this we ensure the best-operational and safe use of the aircraft and create value for our customers.
We are aeronautical engineers, developers and innovators. We make use of cutting edge technologies in our tools as digital enablers are key to ensure our success.
## **Your location**
You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.
## **Our Benefits for You**
- **Fair Compensation & Extras:** Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- **Time for You (and Your Loved Ones):** 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- **Growth Made Easy:** Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- **Feel Good at Work:** On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- **Diversity Connects:** Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.
## **Your tasks and responsibilities**
- You will perform manoeuvre loads calculations covering our fleet from a very early design stage until certification taking into consideration the certification requirements and the A/C specificities such as aerodynamic loads & flight control design.
- You will support research and technology aspects with new aircraft configuration assessments, new services, model based system engineering, automation, and machine learning.
- You would also support airlines through Airbus Customer Services by carrying out L&A analyses of in-service events:
 - Contribute to Loads In-Service Support with trouble shooting activities in the L&A design office context for development and production flight test and in-service aircraft, perform related L&A assessments.
 - Engage for timely response to engineering queries as on-call engineer for Loads In-Service Support.

- You have a Master degree in the STEM field (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics), preferably having focussed on aircraft design

Job Description:
 Alternate Job Titles 
 VLSI Characterization Apprentice 
 Standard Cell Library Development Apprentice 
 CMOS Circuit Simulation Apprentice 
 Digital Library Characterization Trainee 
 Semiconductor Characterization Trainee 
 We Are 
 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 
 You Are 
 You are someone who wants to learn how semiconductor design works, not from slides or theory, but by running real simulations on real circuits that will ship in real products. You spent time in the college understanding CMOS fundamentals and digital logic, and now you want to see how that knowledge translates into production-quality standard cell libraries.  
 You are looking for a structured learning experience where you can work alongside engineers who have been doing characterization and library development for years. You want to build skills that matter, transistor-level debugging, EDA tool fluency, automation scripting, and the discipline to document your work so others can build on it.  
 What You'll Be Doing 
 Run transistor-level simulations on digital standard cells using industry-standard circuit simulators to extract timing, power, and leakage data across PVT corners 
 Analyze CMOS circuit behavior at the transistor level, reviewing schematics, debugging simulation failures, and identifying issues in logic implementation or device models 
 Support characterization and validation of standard cell libraries by running automated flows, reviewing results, and flagging anomalies or quality issues 
 Document simulation results, technical findings, and circuit-level observations in clear, structured reports that senior engineers can act on 
 Collaborate with library development engineers to improve characterization methodologies, refine automation scripts, and close gaps in coverage or accuracy 
 Learn and apply concepts from Liberty (.lib) format, Static Timing Analysis, and low-power design as you work through real library development cycles 
 Participate in technical reviews and team discussions to understand how characterization fits into the broader semiconductor design and IP development process 
 The Impact You Will Have 
 You will contribute to production-quality standard cell libraries that power chip designs across automotive, mobile, AI, and data center applications 
 Your simulations and analysis will help catch timing, power, or functional issues before they reach customers, protecting design schedules and silicon success 
 The characterization data you generate will support SoC designers as they meet performance, power, and area targets 
 Your debugging work will surface circuit-level insights that improve library quality and inform next-generation design decisions 
 You will help build and refine automation flows that make characterization faster, more accurate, and more scalable across technology nodes 
 The documentation and analysis you create will enable senior engineers to make data-driven decisions about library tradeoffs and optimization strategies 
 You will develop a strong foundation in semiconductor characterization and EDA tools that prepares you for the next stage of your engineering career 
 What You'll Need 
 B.E. or B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, VLSI, Microelectronics, or a related field 
 0 to 2 years of experience, fresh graduates are eligible and encouraged to apply 
 Strong understanding of CMOS fundamentals including MOSFET operation, inverter characteristics, static and dynamic logic, noise margins, delay, power dissipation, and leakage mechanisms 
 Solid knowledge of digital logic design including combinational and sequential circuits, Boolean algebra, flip-flops, latches, and timing concepts like setup, hold, recovery, and removal 
 Familiarity with at least one circuit simulator such as PrimeSim, FineSim, and the ability to read and debug transistor-level schematics 
 Comfort working in Linux or Unix environments, basic scripting knowledge in Python, Perl, Tcl, or Shell is a plus 
 Exposure to standard cell libraries, Liberty format, or Static Timing Analysis concepts is a plus 
 Who You Are 
 You can look at a simulation waveform and spot when something is off, whether it is a timing violation, a leakage spike, or a logic glitch, and you are willing to dig in until you understand why 
 You are comfortable working through ambiguity, if a simulation fails or results look strange, you check the netlist, review the setup, and try different scenarios before asking for help 
 You take ownership of your work, when you run a characterization sweep or debug a circuit, you make sure the results are correct and the documentation is clear enough for someone else to pick up where you left off 
 You communicate technical details clearly, whether you are writing up a simulation summary, flagging an issue in a review, or explaining a circuit behaviour to a peer or mentor 
 You are genuinely curious about how things work at the transistor level and eager to learn advanced EDA tools, characterization flows, and semiconductor technologies from experienced engineers
